item.title: Quantum Corridor, Ciena, and Toshiba Validate 1.6 Tb/s Quantum-Safe Encryption on Live Fiber Network
item.summary: Midwest network infrastructure developer Quantum Corridor, optical networking provider Ciena (NYSE: CIEN), and Toshiba have completed a field trial of high-speed quantum-safe optical encryption across a live commercial network.
